resolutions.researcher_notes: Reused a lead already verified by this row's deep-sweep audit (rows/P2210.json): the wiki page's own citation to a DNA India article ('Gujarat Refinery lines up Rs 24,000 cr investment', 2018-03-08). The live dnaindia.com URL now 403s (anti-bot), so I cite the Wayback capture (2018-03-10), which I re-verified live via url_verifier -- HTTP 200, expected content present. The article states the Dahej-to-Koyali pipeline is being built 'at an estimated cost of Rs315 crore', which converts to USD 42.6M at the exchange rate implicit in the wiki's own figure -- an exact match to the sheet's SegmentCost=42,600,000 USD. This is a single source directly stating the number (tier medium, not independent) -- I did NOT count India Investment Grid (indiainvestmentgrid.gov.in, project 701295) as a second corroborating source: IIG gives a different, later 'Total Project Cost: USD 39.61 mn' figure for the same completed project (a ~7% lower, presumably as-built vs. this pre-construction 2018 estimate), so per the standing rule against citing sources that disagree with the recorded value, IIG is not proposed here even though it is a strong, independent, government source -- it supports a DIFFERENT number, not this one. Flagging for Update's awareness: the sheet's cost figure is a 2018 pre-construction estimate, not an as-built actual; IIG's ~7% lower actual-cost figure is available if a value change is later warranted, but that is a human/Update call, not something to resolve in a ref-sweep.
